description.value: One of three large campgrounds in Golden Ears Provincial Park, set in coastal western hemlock forest a short walk from Alouette Lake about an hour east of Vancouver; extremely popular in summer with no cell service in camp.

The fetched website is BC Parks' Golden Ears Park page, which confirms the park is active (trail conditions report dated May 19, 2026) and prominently displays a 'Book camping' call-to-action, confirming reservations are accepted.
